symbols.name: source box array
symbols.meaning: An array indexed by the source box, one of the two inputs to the convolution.
symbols.quote: Let $\phi$ and $\psi$ be arrays indexed by the source box, which has $M=\prod_i s_i$ entries, where $s_i$ is the length of source axis $i$.

symbols.name: second source box array
symbols.meaning: An array indexed by the source box, the second input to the convolution.
symbols.quote: Let $\phi$ and $\psi$ be arrays indexed by the source box, which has $M=\prod_i s_i$ entries, where $s_i$ is the length of source axis $i$.

symbols.name: source box size
symbols.meaning: The number of entries of the source box, the product of the source axis lengths.
symbols.quote: Let $\phi$ and $\psi$ be arrays indexed by the source box, which has $M=\prod_i s_i$ entries, where $s_i$ is the length of source axis $i$.

symbols.name: opposite transform
symbols.meaning: The source transform with the sign of its roots of unity reversed.
symbols.quote: Let $F_s^{+}$ be the opposite transform, whose roots of unity have reversed sign.

relations.quote: The transform identity rests on [Gaussian resampling](gaussian-resampling.md).
The transform identity cancels its retained permutation across a [cyclic convolution](cyclic-convolution.md).
